description: Research retrieval catalog of selected OSHA excavation provisions. Each summary is an authored paraphrase, not the full legal text. Version is for this catalog, not an official OSHA regulatory revision.

regulations.title: Excavation scope
regulations.summary: OSHA Subpart P applies to open earth excavations, including trenches.

regulations.title: Protection from cave-ins
regulations.summary: Employees in excavations generally need an adequate cave-in protective system, with exceptions for excavations entirely in stable rock and for excavations under five feet where a competent-person examination finds no cave-in indication.

regulations.title: Safe trench egress
regulations.summary: Trenches at least four feet deep require a safe way out, such as a ladder or ramp, positioned so employees travel no more than 25 feet laterally.

regulations.title: Falling or rolling excavated materials
regulations.summary: Where excavated materials or equipment could fall or roll into an excavation, protect employees by keeping hazards at least two feet from the edge, using sufficient retaining devices, or combining measures as needed.

regulations.title: Competent-person inspections
regulations.summary: A competent person inspects excavations and protective systems before work, as needed during a shift, and after rainstorms or other hazard-increasing events when employee exposure can reasonably be anticipated.

regulations.title: Underground utility locations
regulations.summary: Before opening an excavation, determine estimated locations of underground utility installations that may reasonably be encountered.

regulations.title: Testing potentially hazardous atmospheres
regulations.summary: For excavations deeper than four feet where oxygen deficiency or another hazardous atmosphere exists or is reasonably expected, test the atmosphere before employees enter.

regulations.title: Hazards from accumulated water
regulations.summary: Employees must not work in an excavation with accumulated or accumulating water unless adequate precautions protect them from the resulting hazards.

regulations.title: Mobile equipment near excavation edges
regulations.summary: When mobile equipment works next to an excavation and its operator lacks a clear view of the edge, use a warning system such as barricades, stop logs, or signals.

regulations.title: Stability of adjacent structures
regulations.summary: Provide support such as shoring, bracing, or underpinning when excavation activity endangers the stability of nearby buildings or other structures.

regulations.title: Walkways and crossings
regulations.summary: Provide walkways where employees or equipment cross excavations and appropriate guardrails when these crossings are at least six feet above lower levels.

regulations.title: Baseline sloping design option
regulations.summary: Under the default sloping option, excavation faces cannot be steeper than one and one-half horizontal to one vertical unless an alternative permitted design option is used.
